The '''Gauntlet''' was a canyon that was used as the entrance for [[Arda Base]]. The terrain of the Gauntlet had lots of tight turns and rock spires. Only skilled pilots could fly through there, so most ships had to be directed by a [[slave circuit]].<ref name="OAA1" />
